purpose: Route a user task to the smallest suitable Roy Tong tool (research, verification, or growth) without confusing discovery, installation, invocation, and successful output.

router.invoke_example: Use find-research-tool to choose the right research tool for this task and give me the safest first successful action.

tools.name: verovo
tools.summary: Buyer-side AI service charge and delivery verification. Review explicit criteria against local evidence, re-count supported bills and keep charging, business acceptance and missing evidence separate.
match: SaaS or AI support invoice re-count
input: a scoped buyer task with explicit charge and/or delivery criteria and relative local JSON evidence paths
a supported billing export (CSV) or the bundled synthetic sample
the vendor whose public billing rules apply
or telemetry fixtures (JSONL) and the metric claims to check
output: separate charge/delivery verdicts, criteria, evidence hashes and offline HTML/JSON reports
bill re-count with findings in both directions and rule provenance
amounts labeled as rule-priced findings, not recovered money
per-invariant PASS / FAIL / AMBIGUOUS / UNPROVABLE for measurement checks
coverage disclosure for what the data cannot decide
tools.invoke_example: Use verovo to review this buyer task against the supplied charge and delivery criteria. Keep source and rule limitations visible; do not turn failed delivery into a refund claim.

first_success.action: Clone https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo, cd verovo, then run python3 healthcheck/verovo review --sample --html buyer-review.html (main preview; not in v0.9.0).
first_success.success: The synthetic local report keeps a matching charge, a failed buyer delivery criterion and a missing observation separate. It is not customer validation.

constraints: Buyer Ledger is pre-M1: catalogued tools are not live-connected and no real platform bill has been validated yet.
A finding is evidence for a review decision, not an accepted claim or a refund.
The review command is a main-branch preview after v0.9.0; tagged installs do not include it.
A human must confirm applicable rules and source truth. No universal contract parsing or automated quality score.
Providers reviewing upstream spend are buyers; downstream provider work requires a concrete transaction.
tools.privacy: Re-counts and checks run locally by default; CLI commands do not upload data.

skill.name: verovo
skill.install_command: gh skill install roy-tong/verovo verovo --agent codex --scope user

tools.name: askovo
tools.summary: Turn a product question into an evidence-led reasoning chain — 场景 → 用户 → 痛点 → 需求 → 特性 → 产品 → 商业 — with platform feasibility, quota planning, E0–E5 evidence grades, counter-evidence gates, and an audit that fails (exit code 1) when a conclusion exceeds its evidence.
match: social media listening for product decisions
Reddit X YouTube Amazon review research
avoid: treating feature mentions or likes as demand
scraping platforms that block third-party collection

skill.name: askovo
skill.install_command: gh skill install roy-tong/askovo askovo --agent codex --scope user

input: research goal (product, user, or scene)
region (cn, overseas, or global) and optional market label
sample size target
platform types (forum, social, video, ecommerce, crowdfunding)
or an existing corpus to audit
output: platform feasibility and collection task list
quota-allocated source plan and platform route matrices
evidence records with E0-E5 grades and provenance
deterministic corpus signals
demand judgments with counter-evidence and gaps
Chinese research-status report
audit exit code 1 with the overclaiming conclusions named
tools.invoke_example: Use askovo to plan a study: goal 'AI 眼镜在海外社媒的用户不满与替代方案', region overseas, sample size 100000, platform types forum+social+video. Report feasibility and the next gate.

first_success.action: Clone the repository, pipx install --editable ., then run askovo demo.
first_success.success: The built-in synthetic case returns status: pass, supported: 1, overclaims: 0 — proving the chain and evidence citations run, not that the demand is real.

constraints: Convenience samples do not support population prevalence or market-share claims.
Only registry-supported open-source connectors may collect; blocked routes stay recorded gaps and are never replaced by commercial providers, merchant APIs, or login-based scraping.
Reddit access requires an approved Data API app registered by 2026-09-30.
tools.privacy: The Skill does not require uploading research questions, source records, identities, or local paths to the maintainer.

tools.name: Growovo
tools.summary: Agent-native GTM operator: 定 → 造 → 跑 — take a shipped product toward verifiable real-user growth (registration, activation, payment), with evidence grades at every step. The mkt kernel (CLI/MCP/Skill) is live; GTM layers are early.
avoid: automating accounts you do not own
input: a shipped product entry (repository or landing page)
ICP and positioning hypotheses
a channel list, or a human-approved campaign plan (data/plans/*.json)
output: repository audits, zero-response issue sweeps and reply drafts
campaign executions with ledger entries and read-back verification screenshots
evidence-graded growth artifacts with PROVEN / PORTED / UNVERIFIED labels
tools.invoke_example: Use Growovo to audit owner/repo health and zero-response issues, then draft a human-approved reply plan. Do not run write operations without --go.

first_success.action: Clone the repository, pip install -r requirements.txt, then run python3 mkt.py github audit --repo roy-tong/verovo (read-only, PROVEN).
first_success.success: The audit prints health findings without writing anything; every write command stays dry-run until --go.

constraints: Only accounts you own or operate; no third-party account automation.
All write operations default to dry-run and require a human-approved plan; the kernel refuses unapproved campaigns.
Commands carry verification levels: PROVEN, PORTED, UNVERIFIED — first runs of UNVERIFIED commands need human supervision.
tools.privacy: Zero-credential CDP: no passwords, tokens or cookies are stored; SMTP credentials only via environment variables; ledger entries and screenshots stay local.

review bindings, export checks, publication receipts, and revision prompts
